title: Salesforce Lead Ingestion & Database Sync
concept: How the webhook endpoint processes and syncs leads from Salesforce

scenarios.name: 401 Signature Error
scenarios.description: HMAC signature mismatch on inbound webhook

scenarios.name: 422 Missing Fields
scenarios.description: Email or company name is empty

nodes.label: Salesforce CRM

ste100.med: Salesforce sends a POST request with lead data when a record changes.
ste100.high: Salesforce triggers an Outbound Webhook when an agent updates a lead record. The message contains the lead identifier, company name, and status code.

nodes.edgeCases: Salesforce retries delivery 3 times with exponential backoff if the endpoint returns a 5xx response code.

nodes.label: Auth Interlock

ste100.med: The gateway verifies the HMAC signature before it parses the body.
ste100.high: The security middleware computes the HMAC SHA-256 hash of the raw request body. The server compares this hash to the signature header using a timing-safe equality check.

validations: Timestamp within 300 seconds window to prevent replay attacks
nodes.edgeCases: If the signature does not match, the gateway drops the connection immediately and returns HTTP 401 Unauthorized.

nodes.label: Zod Schema Gate

ste100.low: The schema check verifies the data.
ste100.med: Zod validates required fields and formats.
ste100.high: The schema validator parses the JSON body against the lead schema. It confirms that the lead identifier matches the standard 18-character format and that the email address is valid.

validations: company name string length between 2 and 120 characters
nodes.edgeCases: If any required field is missing, the validator returns HTTP 422 with an array of field errors.

nodes.label: Sync Processor

ste100.low: The service updates the local record.
ste100.med: The worker normalizes lead properties and schedules an account lookup.
ste100.high: The synchronization service extracts the normalized properties. It transforms the Salesforce status code to the internal system state and maps custom metadata fields.

validations: Idempotency key check against Redis cache
Country code normalization to ISO-3166-1 alpha-2
nodes.edgeCases: If a sync job for the same leadId is already running, the service defers execution using an advisory lock.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL Vault

ste100.med: Prisma saves the lead and creates an audit record.
ste100.high: The database repository runs an upsert query inside a transaction. It updates the lead record and inserts an immutable audit log entry.

validations: Foreign key integrity check on organization_id
nodes.edgeCases: If the database connection pool exhausts, the repository rejects the promise and triggers a dead-letter queue backup.

nodes.label: 401 Unauthorized

ste100.med: The gateway stops the request and returns HTTP 401.
ste100.high: The middleware stops the request before the parser reads the body. It returns HTTP 401 and writes the source IP address to the security log.

validations: No body parsing after a signature mismatch
nodes.edgeCases: Salesforce does not retry a 4xx response, so an operator must fix the shared secret.

nodes.label: 422 Validation Error

ste100.med: The validator returns HTTP 422 with a list of field errors.
ste100.high: The validator collects all failed fields into one array. The gateway returns HTTP 422 with this array, and the worker does not get the job.

nodes.edgeCases: The response lists every failed field, so the sender can fix all errors in one change.

nodes.label: 504 Timeout & DLQ

ste100.low: The system saves the failed job for later.
ste100.med: The repository puts the failed job into the dead-letter queue.
ste100.high: The repository stops the transaction after 5 seconds. It puts the job into the dead-letter queue, and the gateway returns HTTP 504.

nodes.edgeCases: A scheduled worker reads the dead-letter queue every 10 minutes and tries the job again.
